title: althaea minoricensis
intro: Althaea minoricensis, commonly known as Minorican marshmallow, is a plant species within the Malvaceae family, characterized by its thick, fleshy roots. It is used for its potential health benefits, including soothing digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and aiding in wound healing. The therapeutic actions attributed to Althaea minoricensis include demulcent, anti-inflammatory, and emollient properties, which help to protect and moisturize mucous membranes. The bioactive constituents of Althaea minoricensis include mucilages, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
